knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Import

```{r}
dati <- read.csv("data/students.csv")

str(dati)

```

## summary

```{r}
summary(dati)
```


## plot

```{r}
hist(dati$classes_attended)
boxplot(dati$classes_attended)


hist(dati$assignments_submitted)
boxplot(dati$assignments_submitted)

```

```{r}

table(dati$classes_attended,dati$assignments_submitted)

plot(dati$classes_attended,dati$assignments_submitted)


```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(dati,aes(x=classes_attended,y=assignments_submitted,colour = student_id))+geom_point()


dati$student_id=factor(dati$student_id)
ggplot(dati,aes(x=classes_attended,y=assignments_submitted,colour = student_id))+geom_point()+theme(legend.position = "none")



ggplot(dati,aes(x=classes_attended,y=assignments_submitted))+
 geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              colour = "black") +geom_jitter(
    width = 0.10,
    height = 0.10,
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.45,
    colour = "#2C7FB8"
  ) 
```
